items.title: Delhi HC issues notice on IYC's protest-permission plea, lists it for Nov 17; Centre says Jantar Mantar de-notification kills the plea
items.summary: Justice Amit Mahajan issued notice on prayers (c), (d) and (f) of IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib's petition challenging Delhi Police's Oct-1 rejection of permission to protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar (IYC had applied Sep 25 for a ~100-150-person protest). The prayers challenge the 2022 Standing Order's use as an automatic protest bar without individualised assessment, seek a fresh reasoned reconsideration of the request, and argue the 10-day rule is not an absolute bar. Sr Adv Siddharth Luthra called the rejection a 'completely non-speaking order... frivolous'; ASG Chetan Sharma opposed notice, saying the entire plea concerns Jantar Mantar which has been de-notified pursuant to Supreme Court orders — and unless the de-notification itself is challenged, the petition cannot sustain. Matter listed November 17.
